_comment: Harness scope is executable, not a memo. States are not_started | active | blocked | passing. WIP=1 is enforced by scripts/verify-harness.ps1.

features.behavior: A fresh agent can identify the project, current phase, canonical instructions, architecture route, and verification command from repository files.
features.verification: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-harness.ps1 -Area Instructions

features.behavior: A fresh agent can resume from durable state, decisions, and a WIP-limited feature list without relying on chat history.
features.verification: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-harness.ps1 -Area State

features.behavior: The repository has an executable completion contract that distinguishes the current harness gate from future runtime and end-to-end gates.
features.verification: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-harness.ps1 -Area Verification

features.behavior: An operator can use the Dockerized FastAPI/PostgreSQL/Next.js stack to create a vendor, upload a COI-shaped document, verify normalized fields against deterministic requirements, review and correct exceptions, and retrieve an append-only point-in-time compliance status with audit evidence.
features.verification: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-mvp.ps1
features.evidence: scripts/verify-mvp.ps1 passed on 2026-08-03: Dockerized PostgreSQL 16/FastAPI/Next.js flow created a vendor, uploaded a COI, produced needs_review, applied a human certificate-holder correction, produced compliant, retained 2 snapshots, and exposed 4 ledger events; frontend smoke returned HTTP 200. Backend pytest against Compose PostgreSQL: 6 passed.

features.behavior: Local credentials are stored only in ignored .env files, required runtime configuration fails clearly when absent, and tracked files contain no usable credential defaults.
features.verification: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-secrets.ps1; docker compose --env-file .env --file docker-compose.yml config --quiet
features.evidence: 2026-08-04: scripts/check-secrets.ps1 passed; Compose config with ignored .env passed; backend settings import passed; scripts/verify-mvp.ps1 passed against the new PostgreSQL volume; old volume preserved.

features.behavior: A fresh agent can execute and verify the complete-product task plan with one active work package and durable evidence.
features.verification: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-harness.ps1 -Area All; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-fresh-session.ps1
features.evidence: 2026-08-04: harness All passed; verify-fresh-session.ps1 passed; verify-product.ps1 correctly blocked with 15 open required work packages and a repair path.

features.behavior: An authorized user can operate an isolated organization/workspace with role-based delivery or handoff access.
features.verification: Tenant-isolation, RLS, role-matrix, authentication, and browser E2E suite
features.evidence: 2026-08-04: scripts/verify-tenancy.ps1 passed against real Docker Compose/PostgreSQL with two tenants, two workspaces each, six canonical roles, scope denials, disabled membership/session rejection, F01 compatibility, and append-only audit evidence; tests/tenancy/browser_smoke.py passed against the live stack; backend pytest 11 passed; frontend typecheck/build passed; scripts/verify-mvp.ps1 passed.

features.behavior: A workflow owner can capture discovery, sign an immutable baseline, and inspect deterministic opportunity scoring inputs and outputs.
features.verification: Discovery, signature, immutability, formula, and scoring E2E suite
features.evidence: 2026-08-04: scripts/verify-discovery.ps1 static and real Compose/PostgreSQL E2E passed; backend PostgreSQL suite passed 14 tests; frontend typecheck/build passed; live Playwright browser flow verified authenticated structured intake, multipart SOP/transcript ingestion, human draft save, signed immutable baseline, and canonical opportunity.v1 score binding.

features.behavior: A builder can define a versioned DAG workflow and publish only an immutable version that passes its evaluation gate.
features.verification: DAG validation, version immutability, read-only graph, and publish-gate E2E suite
features.evidence: 2026-08-04: scripts/verify-workflows.ps1 passed static, real Compose/PostgreSQL HTTP, and live browser checks; HTTP evidence covered workspace isolation, schema/cycle/reference rejection, read-only graph, immutable SHA-256 versions, evaluation-gated publish, RBAC, and append-only audit; frontend 6 contract tests/typecheck/build passed; backend 20 workflow/regression tests passed in the isolated stack.

features.behavior: A durable worker can execute workflow nodes with retries, idempotency, human waits, outbox events, crash recovery, and replay without side effects.
features.verification: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-runtime.ps1; python -m pytest -q backend/tests/runtime/test_runtime_postgres.py
features.evidence: 2026-08-04: scripts/verify-runtime.ps1 passed static, real Compose/PostgreSQL HTTP, and authenticated browser checks for pinned graph order, idempotency, approval/resume, exactly-once external-write receipts, safe replay, outbox dispatch, stale-claim recovery, RBAC, and workspace isolation; runtime PostgreSQL integration test passed 1 test; frontend typecheck, 6 contract tests, and production build passed.

features.behavior: An operator can process a prioritized review queue using keyboard controls, field provenance, corrections, escalation, SLA, and guarded bulk actions.
features.verification: Real-browser keyboard, provenance, queue, SLA, correction, escalation, and bulk-cap E2E suite

features.behavior: A workspace administrator can configure scoped MCP and first-party connectors with encrypted, rotated credentials and complete call logging.
features.verification: Connector sandbox, tool allow-list, vault encryption/rotation, redaction, and webhook security suite

features.behavior: A workflow owner can configure versioned confidence routing and simulate the auto/review/halt tradeoff with sampled-audit protection.
features.verification: Confidence calibration, threshold simulator, sampled audit, and false-auto E2E suite

features.behavior: A workflow version is publishable only when golden-set metrics and injection canaries pass, with drift monitoring after release.

features.behavior: An authorized user can inspect every run and safely replay it against an immutable version without external side effects.
features.verification: Inspector drill-down, trace correlation, redaction, and side-effect-free replay E2E suite

features.behavior: A sponsor can reconcile immutable value events, costs, ROI dashboards, drill-down records, and CSV/PDF exports to a signed baseline.
features.verification: Ledger reconciliation, dashboard parity, drill-down, and CSV/PDF export suite
